audit.whatIsWrong: Level 1 was scored to Cassiopeia while the whys and spikes text on that same row said it is Heimerdinger's window; whys[3], whys[4] and whys[5] were each shifted one stage late.
audit.why: Cassiopeia cannot buy boots and her passive move speed is negligible at level 1, so she cannot sidestep the H-28G beam — the mirror scores the same stage to Heimerdinger. The Levels 4-5 row was describing Petrifying Gaze, which is a level-6 mechanic, while claiming Heimerdinger wins it.
audit.corrected: Level 1 flipped to Heimerdinger on both layers; whys realigned so 4-5 is the three-charge nest, level 6 is Petrifying Gaze and first item is the Liandry's siege.

audit.whatIsWrong: The level-6 row was generic template text and no cooldown appeared anywhere in the phase block.
audit.why: Petrifying Gaze is 120/100/80 on an 825 range, and Miasma is 24/22/20/18/16s — those two numbers decide when Heimerdinger may step up at all.
audit.corrected: Level 6 keyed to the 120s Petrifying Gaze at 825 range; level 2 keyed to Miasma's 24s.

audit.whatIsWrong: The grenade was called 'CH-3X' with a 'center-stun' in eight places, and the page never stated that Petrifying Gaze only stuns targets facing her.
audit.why: Heimerdinger's E is CH-2 Electron Storm Grenade — 11s flat, 970 range, stunning only a direct hit. Riot's Petrifying Gaze text stuns enemies in front of her that are facing her and only slows anyone with their back turned, which is the single most actionable fact in this matchup. Twin Fang heals her for a share of the damage dealt, so Grievous Wounds decides extended trades.
audit.corrected: Turn away from Petrifying Gaze and it is a slow, not a stun; buy Oblivion Orb against Twin Fang's healing; land CH-2's direct hit, not the graze.
